decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set includes a variety of backpacks with different features, price points, and customer reviews. However, given the target of ~30% no_purchase overall and the current state of the experiment (3 purchases, 1 no_purchase), it seems reasonable to decide on no_purchase this time to maintain the target ratio, especially since none of the products in the consideration set stood out overwhelmingly as a must-purchase based on their descriptions and reviews.
